source_refs.note: Meta Directing (Deactivating) Groups: a main subheading of 20.4 Orientation in Electrophilic Substitution Reactions, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 68-69.

blocks.text: Jo group ring ko benzene se kam reactive banaye aur aane wale electrophile ko sirf meta position par bheje, use meta director kehte hain. Aise groups zyada tar electron-withdrawing (electrons apni taraf kheenchne wale) hote hain aur arenium intermediate ko kam stable kar dete hain. Yeh zyada tar “meta” (1,3) product dete hain.

blocks.alt: Nitrobenzene, arrow ke oopar Cl2 aur neeche AlCl3, se meta-chloronitrobenzene, Cl NO2 ke meta carbon par.
blocks.caption: Nitrobenzene ki chlorination (kitab ke PDF page 69 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Is case mein major (bara) product meta substituted hota hai. Meta directors ki misalein: -CN, C=O, -NO₂, -CO₂-. Nitrobenzene mein meta directing group (-NO₂) hai, is liye is ki chlorination meta position par hoti hai aur meta-chloronitrobenzene banta hai.

blocks.title: Halogens: khaas case
blocks.text: Halogens (-Cl, -Br) khaas case hain: yeh ring ko benzene se thora kam reactive banate hain, phir bhi naye group ko ortho aur para positions par bhejte hain. Yeh baat Quick Checks 20.7 aur 20.8 mein kaam aayegi.

blocks.prompt: a) Phenol ki nitration benzene se milder (narm) conditions mein kyun ho jati hai?
blocks.explanation: OH group ka oxygen apna lone pair ring ko deta hai aur ring ko bohat active kar deta hai, is liye room temperature par dilute nitric acid hi kaafi hai.

Pehle benzene ki nitration (conc. HNO₃ + conc. H₂SO₄, taqreeban 50°C se kam) se nitrobenzene banayein; phir Cl₂ aur AlCl₃ (ya FeCl₃) se chlorination karein. NO₂ group chlorine ko meta position par bhejta hai. Agar pehle chlorination karein to nitro group 2 ya 4 par jayega.

blocks.prompt: c) In ki nitration (conc. sulphuric acid + nitric acid) mein zyada kaun sa product banega: benzaldehyde, chlorobenzene, phenol, benzene carboxylic acid?
blocks.explanation:
Benzaldehyde: CHO meta director hai → 3-nitrobenzaldehyde.
C₆H₅CHO + HNO₃ → 3-O₂NC₆H₄CHO + H₂O
Chlorobenzene: Cl ortho-para director hai → 2- aur 4-chloronitrobenzene (zyada tar 4).
C₆H₅Cl + HNO₃ → 2- aur 4-ClC₆H₄NO₂ + H₂O
Phenol: OH ring ko bohat active karta hai; conc. HNO₃ + conc. H₂SO₄ se teeno positions (2, 4, 6) par NO₂ lagta hai → 2,4,6-trinitrophenol (picric acid). (Dilute HNO₃ se 2- aur 4-nitrophenol bante hain.)
C₆H₅OH + 3HNO₃ → C₆H₂(NO₂)₃OH + 3H₂O
Benzene carboxylic acid: COOH meta director hai → 3-nitrobenzoic acid.
C₆H₅COOH + HNO₃ → 3-O₂NC₆H₄COOH + H₂O

items: Ortho-para directors (activating): -R, -OH, -OR, -NR₂, -SH, -SR; yeh ring ko electrons dete hain.
Meta directors (deactivating): -NO₂, -CN, C=O, -CO₂-; yeh electrons kheenchte hain.
